liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **The Other One V1**: rare: 5 archived performances [15]
- **Playin' in the Band Reprise**: rare: 12 archived performances [15]
- **The Other One V2**: rare: 4 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **deadco2023-07-15.EJL95** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **deadco2023-07-15.rasbobre**: source not stated; 19 songs; 177 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this newer version of the recording almost perfect; Reviewer praises the clarity and tone of It Hurts Me Too in this transfer [11]
- **deadco2023-07-15.sennmke4010.mbhoka200.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 179 min [3]
- **deadco2023-07-15.mbhoka200.v3.flac24**: source not stated; 19 songs; 179 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer describes this as the second-to-last Dead & Company show, taped from the audience [8]
- Taper promotes a charity shirt supporting the National Brain Tumor Society, tied to his friend Jon "Bubbles" Heller [1]
- After the first set, reviewer says the band may be at its best, with chemistry between Mayer and Chimenti [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2023-07-15.EJL95**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: AKG c414 XLII Hypercardioids PAS 20" apart > Channels 3 & 4: Audio Technica 3031 Cardioids PAS 32" apart > Channels 5 & 6: Vanguard V1… [1]. Also: Chain: SD to WAV, then Reaper for tracking, normalizing and EQ, then 24-bit FLAC [1]
- **deadco2023-07-15.rasbobre**: taped by RasBobre; source: SP-CMC-8 > Zoom H6 > Audacity [2]. Also: Chain: Zoom Handy H6 recorder, then Audacity; 24-bit and not intended for CD burning [2]
- **deadco2023-07-15.sennmke4010.mbhoka200.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: SennMKE4010 (din)+MBHOka200 (dina)->V3->Zoom F8Pro(48/32) [3]. Also: Bob Crupi recorded and transferred it, with mics at 11 feet on a stand taped to the front platform rail; Transfer: Kingston SDXC to Cakewalk mixdown, then Sound Forge 11, 24-bit with iZotope MBIT+ dither, then FLAC [3]
- **deadco2023-07-15.mbhoka200.v3.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: MBHOka200 (dina)->V3->Zoom F8Pro(48/32) [4]. Also: Bob Crupi recorded it from a stand taped to the front platform rail, with mics at 11 feet; Transfer: Kingston SDXC to Sound Forge 11, 24-bit with iZotope MBIT+ dither, then FLAC; this is the v3 version [4]
